title: Add M5 UI scaffolding: Layer 1 sliders, preset selector, layer toggle, IndexedDB persistence, PNG/SVG/GeoJSON exports
description:
## M5 — UI for Layer 1 + persistence + exports (first ship-ready milestone)

Per .design/realistic-planet-generator.md M5 + REQ-7 + REQ-12 + REQ-14, and design.md §6.1 + §7 + §10. Builds on M0-M4 (main HEAD `9b7bcdd`). This is the first shippable v0 — real users can drive the pipeline end-to-end via UI controls.

### In scope

1. **Layer 1 control panel (`src/components/ControlPanel/Layer1Sliders.tsx`)**:
   - All ~24 parameters from design.md §6.1 grouped into sections:
     - **Astronomical**: planet radius, surface gravity, axial tilt, rotation period, stellar flux, orbital eccentricity.
     - **Tectonic**: plate count, mean plate velocity, continental fraction, sim duration, tectonic activity multiplier, freeze plate topology toggle.
     - **Hydrosphere**: sea level offset, mean atmospheric temperature, atmospheric density, water inventory.
     - **Biosphere**: has life toggle, vegetation density.
     - **Mesh**: mesh level (6/7/8 default/9 ultra).
     - **Erosion** (subset exposed): erodibility multiplier, diffusivity multiplier.
     - **Climate**: solar constant override (default Earth), thermal inertia ratios.
   - Slider for numeric, toggle for bool, dropdown for enum where appropriate.
   - Live values bound to Zustand `appStore.params` slice.
   - "Run sim" button that triggers `worker.runFullSim(seed)`.

2. **Preset selector (`src/components/ControlPanel/PresetSelector.tsx`)** — 7 named presets per design.md §6.1:
   - Earth-like (defaults)
   - Mars-like (smaller, drier, no life, low gravity)
   - Ocean world (high water, low continental fraction)
   - Young volcanic (high tectonic activity, short sim)
   - Old worn world (low tectonic activity, long sim, much erosion)
   - Pangaea (low plate count, single supercontinent)
   - Archipelago (high plate count, low continental fraction, fragmented)
   - Selecting a preset overwrites all Layer 1 params; sliders reflect the new values.

3. **Layer toggle (`src/components/ControlPanel/LayerToggle.tsx`)** — switches the visible globe layer:
   - elevation (heightmap palette: deep blue → coastal green → brown → snow)
   - plate ID (categorical colors)
   - crust age (gradient)
   - temperature (cool blue → hot red)
   - precipitation (dry yellow → wet blue)
   - prevailing winds (vector overlay or arrow glyphs)
   - ocean currents (vector overlay)
   - biome (categorical via Whittaker palette)
   - drainage basins (categorical by basin ID)
   - rivers (highlighted along high-flow cells)
   - lakes (filled regions)
   - time-since-uplift (gradient red young → green old)
   - sediment depth (gradient)

4. **IndexedDB persistence (`src/persistence/idb.ts`)**:
   - Schema: `planets` object store keyed by user-given name. Each planet record holds: Layer 1 params, Layer 2 constraints (empty for M5), seed, snapshot blob (compressed Float32Array/Uint32Array data per cell). 
   - Save planet: serialize current sim state, write to IDB.
   - Load planet: read from IDB, restore Layer 1 + (later) Layer 2, replay seed via worker, restore snapshot.
   - Save/load presets separately in `presets` object store.
   - Version + migrate function for future schema changes.

5. **Export panel (`src/components/ExportPanel/`)**:
   - **PNG export** — render the current visible layer at the chosen projection (equirectangular default, plus Mercator / Robinson / orthographic options) at user-selectable resolution (default 4096×2048). Use OffscreenCanvas + the globe-fragment shader applied to a flat surface.
   - **SVG export** — vector representation of: continents (coastlines), rivers (polylines), settlement markers (when M8 lands; placeholder layer for M5). Use d3-geo for projection of cell coordinates to 2D.
   - **GeoJSON / TopoJSON export** — features for: continents, rivers, lakes, drainage basins, biomes (as polygons). Use `topojson-client` for compact encoding.
   - One file per format in `src/export/{png,svg,geojson}.ts`.

6. **App layout integration (`src/App.tsx`, refresh)**:
   - Top-level layout with sidebar (control panel) + main canvas (globe) + status bar.
   - Status bar shows sim progress (REQ-13: doesn't block UI).
   - Validation messages area (placeholder for M6 constraint validation).

7. **Tests**:
   - Layer 1 store: every parameter slider reads/writes the Zustand store correctly.
   - Preset selector: each of 7 presets sets the expected param values.
   - IDB roundtrip: save a planet → reload → load returns bit-identical Layer 1 params + simulation state.
   - PNG export: produces a valid PNG file (signature check + dimension match).
   - SVG export: produces parseable SVG with expected element counts.
   - GeoJSON export: validates against geojson.org schema.

### Out of scope (do not start)
- M6 Layer 2 painted constraints (brushes, validation, suggestions).
- M7 regional refinement (level 10 spherical clipped subset).
- M8/M10 civilization layer.
- Foundry VTT / Roll20 exports — deferred per design doc.

### Acceptance criteria for M5
- [ ] All ~24 Layer 1 parameters surface as UI controls of appropriate type.
- [ ] All 7 presets selectable; selection overwrites all params; verified by Vitest test fixture.
- [ ] Layer toggle switches at least 8 distinct visible-data layers in the Globe component (paint test for non-WebGPU environment is fine).
- [ ] IDB save → reload → load roundtrip is bit-identical for Layer 1 params + simulation snapshot.
- [ ] PNG export produces a valid file (signature + dimensions).
- [ ] SVG export parses without error in a browser (jsdom test fine).
- [ ] GeoJSON export validates against the geojson.org schema.
- [ ] M0-M4 test suites still pass after M5 changes (regression).
- [ ] `npm test` + `tsc --noEmit` both pass.
- [ ] No stubs / TODOs / "implement later". M6 (constraints) and M7 (regional) hooks may be commented type signatures only.

### Lesson from M0/M1/M2/M3/M4 stall pattern
**Commit each major group as you finish.** M3 and M4-round-2 succeeded by following this. The tmux checkpoint nudge worked when needed. M5 has natural commit groups: control panel slice, preset selector, layer toggle, IDB persistence, each export format. Aim for 5-7 commits across the milestone.

### References
- .design/realistic-planet-generator.md REQ-7 (Layer 1 params), REQ-12 (persistence), REQ-14 (exports), REQ-13 (UI perf), AC-7, AC-12, AC-14
- design.md §6.1 (Layer 1 parameter list), §7 (UI architecture), §10 (tech stack — uses idb, d3-geo, topojson-client, svg.js), §11 (planned source tree)
- M0-M4 main HEAD `9b7bcdd` provides the simulation pipeline; M5 wires UI on top.
